spec_match.rationale: Implements the working group's named motivating use case (labelling both sides of a circular path) with the real side="right" attribute on one badge and the real pre-side workaround (hand-flipped arc sweep flag) on the other.

interactive.rationale: Top text, bottom text, and font-size controls re-render both seals live, and every change re-measures both bottom arcs with getRotationOfChar/getExtentOfChar.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index blurb promises the workaround next to the side version with a measured which-renders-upright verdict, and the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles empty/hidden bottom text (cannot-measure branch), and the unsupported branch is a first-class outcome: the side badge's bottom line measurably lands in the wrong half and the verdict says why.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5422782593761280 and the spec's TextPathElementSideAttribute anchor.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's closed-circle geometric assertion (side-right-places-text-inside-closed-circle) is the exact contract this badge depends on; baseline assertions cover the arcs the workaround uses.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified headless (Chromium 141) with screenshots read at both device classes: workaround badge measured upright (verdict green), side badge measured not-as-intended (verdict red, bottom line at top), console clean, controls driven over CDP.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts manual-reversed-arc-renders-upright on the always-available workaround path, and the side supported/fallback branch is asserted separately without labelling the fallback as success.

design_system.rationale: Seal artwork uses CSS variables through classes (star uses accent-blue on ivory), verdict lines pair colour with wording, and buttons keep the background+colour pairing rule.

accessibility.rationale: Both SVGs carry role=img with a desc, per-badge verdicts are text (not colour alone), announcements go through one debounced polite live region, and all controls are labelled native inputs with visible focus.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Badges stack to one column under 270px-per-track via auto-fit minmax with a min(100%) guard, SVGs scale via viewBox, no horizontal overflow measured at 360px; verified at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the two badges converge on a Chrome 156 build
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 141 the side badge's bottom line measurably renders at the top (rotation ~0 but centre-y in the upper half) and the page says so. On a supporting build, verify both bottom arcs measure upright in the lower half and the two seals are visually interchangeable.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce live state changes screen reader aria-live
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: One polite live region per page, debounced when updates can fire rapidly; per-item status also available as static text; never colour-only state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The combined measurement summary goes through a single debounced (300ms) polite output; the per-badge verdict lines are aria-live=off static text with explicit wording plus colour, so typing in the text inputs does not double-announce.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: grid auto-fit with minmax(min(100%, N), 1fr) so tracks never force overflow on narrow screens; svg as display:block with intrinsic ratio from viewBox.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The two-badge grid uses repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 270px), 1fr)) and both SVGs are display:block, inline-size 100%, block-size auto.

summary: The practical-product angle: a round seal whose top and bottom arcs both read left-to-right, built twice — once with side="right" on a single circle, once with the hand-reversed bottom arc every production badge uses today — with getRotationOfChar-based measured verdicts under each badge stating which one this browser actually renders upright.
